description.ja: 『GUNDAM FACTORY YOKOHAMA』の動く実物大ガンダムの限定商品がエコプラで登場！
description.en: "GUNDAM FACTORY YOKOHAMA"'s moving life-sized Gundam limited edition product is now available in Ecopla!

description.ja: 動くガンダムの挙動を1/144スケールで再現可能
description.en: The behavior of a moving Gundam can be reproduced in 1/144 scale.

description.ja: • 歩行、右腕上げ、両腕あげなど動くガンダムの挙動を再現できる可動域！
description.en: • Range of motion that allows you to reproduce Gundam's movements such as walking, raising the right arm, raising both arms, etc.!

description.ja: • ガンプラHGシリーズと同等の可動を完全新規金型で再現。
description.en: • Reproduce the same movement as the GunplaHG series with a completely new mold.

description.ja: • 動くガンダム「RX-78F00」のディティールを徹底再現。
description.en: • Thorough reproduction of the details of the moving Gundam "RX-78F00".
